title: Extended GitHub outage recovery (deferred from v4)
question: How does delivery continue and recover through an extended GitHub outage or lost coordination state?
answer: Extended GitHub outage recovery is deferred off the v4 critical path. v4 still requires basic visible error and pending state and refusal of unverifiable unsafe assignments or writes; extended recovery waits for a post-v4 capability.

confirmation.basis: Owner deferred extended outage recovery off the v4 critical path; relayed as settled on 2026-10-01.
